label: LongMemEval
summary: Each question is a unit: its chat history goes into the memory under test a session at a time, the question is recalled against it, LongMemEval's reader prompt answers from what came back, and LongMemEval's own judge says whether the answer is right.

datasets.label: LongMemEval-M · cleaned
datasets.summary: About 500 sessions of history per question. Needs about 5.5 GB of free disk.

datasets.label: LongMemEval · evidence sessions only
datasets.summary: Only the sessions that hold each question's evidence.

datasets.label: LongMemEval-S · as first released
datasets.summary: The S file as first released in 2024, before the authors cleaned it. The paper's numbers come from it.

datasets.label: LongMemEval-M · as first released
datasets.summary: The M file as first released in 2024. Needs about 5.5 GB of free disk.

nop.from: Nullius: no capability runs and nothing is recalled; the answer is empty. The 30 abstention questions in each dataset are right when the answer says it cannot answer, so the judge may pass an empty one; it also passes an empty answer by mistake now and then.

oracle.from: Nullius, from the authors' answers: the question's answer field in the authors' file (for an abstention question, their explanation of why it cannot be answered), given to the judge as the answer. The judge, a model, rejects about one in twenty of them.
oracle.in_prompt: A comparison question names its answer among the options it offers ('A or B?'), with the other option beside it.

score.says: LongMemEval's own judge (src/evaluation/evaluate_qa.py): its prompt for the question's type (abstention questions: whether the answer says it cannot be answered), sent by its own client call, answered yes or no

judge.says: the paper's judge, gpt-4o, at temperature 0, ten tokens

question_type.label: Question type
question_type.summary: Which memory ability the run measures: every question, or only the questions of one type.

reading.summary: Whether the model answers from recalled memory directly or first identifies relevant facts and reasons through them.

about.con: Chain-of-note in one call: prepare_prompt's history-chats template with cot, gen_length 800. The upstream's default.
about.direct: The template without cot, gen_length 500: the answer at once.

retriever.summary: Whether the model receives the full conversation history, no history, or sessions or turns selected by a retrieval method.

about.full-history-session: --retriever_type orig-session: every session, latest kept first when the history is cut to the window.
about.full-history-turn: --retriever_type orig-turn: every turn, each its own chunk.
about.flat-bm25-session: run_retrieval.py flat-bm25 at session granularity (a session's user turns are its key), then --retriever_type flat-session: the top-k sessions.
about.flat-bm25-turn: run_retrieval.py flat-bm25 at turn granularity (a user turn is the key), then --retriever_type flat-turn: the top-k rounds.
about.flat-contriever-session: run_retrieval.py flat-contriever (facebook/contriever, mean pooling) at session granularity, then --retriever_type flat-session.
about.flat-contriever-turn: run_retrieval.py flat-contriever at turn granularity, then --retriever_type flat-turn.
about.flat-stella-session: run_retrieval.py flat-stella (Stella V5 1.5B, its 1024-dimension head) at session granularity; the model fetched into the upstream's model_cache first, as its README has it downloaded by hand. Its fixed batch of 64 needs at least 12000 MiB of GPU memory.
about.flat-stella-turn: run_retrieval.py flat-stella at turn granularity, then --retriever_type flat-turn.

topk.label: Top-k
topk.summary: The maximum number of conversation sessions or turns the model receives when answering a question.

history_format.summary: Whether conversation history is shown to the model as JSON or as lines of text labelled by speaker.

useronly.label: User turns only
useronly.summary: Whether conversation history includes only user messages or both user and assistant messages.

merge_key_expansion.summary: Whether retrieved conversations are shown in full, replaced by their user text, or combined with that text.

separate_notes.label: Separate notes
separate_notes.summary: Write a separate note for each retrieved session or turn before reasoning. Original memory only.

cuda_gpu.summary: An NVIDIA GPU with CUDA, for LongMemEval's Contriever retrievers.

stella_gpu.summary: An NVIDIA GPU with CUDA and at least 12000 MiB of GPU memory, for Stella's fixed batch of 64.

original.summary: LongMemEval's long-context reader as the paper ran it: its own src/generation/run_generation.py on one question, as run_generation.sh runs it - the history in the prompt (or what the paper's BM25 retrieval ranks), cut to the reader's 128k window, its prompts, temperature 0 and answer length - scored by its own src/evaluation/evaluate_qa.py with its judge, gpt-4o.
original.paper: Table 2 (long-context reading) and Figure 5 onward (retrieval-augmented reading)

model.summary: The same pipeline with any model in the reader's place: LongMemEval's code asks for gpt-4o - its 128k window, the history cut to fit it, its answer length - and the relay sends the model chosen. Its scores compare with other runs of this setup, not with the paper.
